Package com.example.volt.voice

Class VoiceManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.voice.VoiceManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.robotemi.sdk.Robot.AsrListener, com.robotemi.sdk.Robot.TtsListener
public class VoiceManager extends Object implements com.robotemi.sdk.Robot.AsrListener, com.robotemi.sdk.Robot.TtsListener
VoiceManager orchestrates a two-step voice flow with temi: (1) prompt user to say a destination; (2) ask for confirmation (yes/no). It owns the conversation state machine and mediates between ASR callbacks and app commands.

Representation Invariant:

  • VoiceButton != null
  • goToCommand != null

Abstraction Function:

A VoiceManager vm represents an interactive voice controller such that:
  • vm.VoiceButton triggers the start of the voice interaction when clicked.
  • vm.asrState governs the dialogue phase: awaiting a word or awaiting confirmation.
  • vm.pendingWord holds the latest uttered destination to be confirmed/executed.
  • vm.goToCommand is invoked with the confirmed destination.

Thread-safety: Android callbacks are on the main thread; the few volatile fields protect against reordering if future background interactions are introduced.
